name: California Electric Child #0
description: The memories of snow fading in the background, angels passing by, a siren. The sound of steps on a boardwalk full of stars, sunshine scorching and loving. Once stuck between mountains and lakes in a square and crossed country, now with the responsibility of total freedom. Tourists and locals passing by, in an incessant choreography, the Child watches, while smelling the air full of sea and sunset. Suddenly a hand delicately touches his shoulders, he turns around, looks up and sees the reassuring and smiling eyes of Miss California. A wave of electricity passes through them, through the air, through the world. From a far far away country to the land of movies, the Child is reborn and says Hi.
